description: Na₃Sm₉B₈O₂₇ crystallizes in the hexagonal P̅62m space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.59 Å. There are two inequivalent Sm sites. In the first Sm site, Sm is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Sm-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.65 Å. In the second Sm site, Sm is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Sm-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.65 Å. There are three inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All B-O bond lengths are 1.39 Å. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All B-O bond lengths are 1.40 Å. In the third B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All B-O bond lengths are 1.37 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Sm, and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Sm atoms to form distorted corner-sharing OSm₄ trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, three Sm, and one B atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Sm and one B atom.
